purpose: Compare Japanese semantic retrieval over official English model metadata; preserve catalogue absence and qualifiers.
metadataPublication: Do not publish the bulk metadata or website renders. Publish identifiers, scores, own assessments and source links only.
model: Existing verified sentence-transformers/paraphrase-multilingual-MiniLM-L12-v2 int8 ONNX, CPU only
candidateCaption: Official name followed by description when available; no added Japanese aliases, category rewriting or query-specific correction.
acceptance: Similarity is a ranking, not a proof of object identity. Report top1, top3, qualifier loss and catalogue absence separately after reading results. No threshold tuning, retries or invented matches.
meshSelection: Up to three distinct suitable top-ranked models that match a query object. Prefer vase, watering can, sword if present; otherwise chair, barrel, football, horse statue in that order. No more than three downloads; 1GB total maximum. Keep original model files and create separate geometry-only GLB.
